title: Support of network slice admission control and interworking with EPC

entities.name: Network Slice Admission Control
entities.description: Procedure performed by the network to monitor and control the number of UEs per network slice and number of PDU sessions per network slice during PDN connection establishment.

entities.name: PDN Connection Establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a PDN connection, during which network slice admission control is performed.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information used to identify network slices.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: EPS counting required
entities.description: Condition where EPS counting is required for a network slice, triggering network slice admission control.

entities.name: Maximum number of UEs reached
entities.description: Condition where the maximum number of UEs on a network slice associated with an S-NSSAI has been reached.

entities.name: Maximum number of PDU sessions reached
entities.description: Condition where the maximum number of PDU sessions on a network slice associated with an S-NSSAI has been reached.

entities.name: Reject PDN connectivity request
entities.description: Network behavior to reject PDN connectivity request with ESM cause #26 'insufficient resources' when maximum UE or PDU session limits are reached.

entities.name: ESM cause #26
entities.description: ESM cause value indicating 'insufficient resources' used when rejecting PDN connectivity requests.

relations.description: EPS counting requirement triggers network slice admission control procedure.
Network slice admission control is performed during PDN connection establishment procedure.
Network slice admission control monitors and controls resources per S-NSSAI.
Maximum UE limit condition leads to PDN connectivity request rejection.
Maximum PDU session limit condition leads to PDN connectivity request rejection.
PDN connectivity request rejection includes ESM cause #26 'insufficient resources'.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message may contain S-NSSAI information elements.
